headline: NCP to hold protest rally in Habiganj after attacks on leaders
summary: National Citizen Party leaders, including Nahid Islam, will gather Wednesday to protest attacks by BNP's student wing, Chhatra Dal, during a 'July March'.
details: The National Citizen Party (NCP) will hold a protest rally in Habiganj city on Wednesday afternoon to condemn attacks on its leaders' motorcade during the 'July March' program.
caption:
NCP leaders were attacked in Habiganj, leaving several injured. Now, they are returning for a massive protest rally.

The National Citizen Party (NCP) will hold a protest rally in Habiganj city on Wednesday afternoon to condemn attacks on its leaders' motorcade during the 'July March' program.

#Habiganj #NCP #Politics #Bangladesh #Protest

Source: Prothom Alo

headline_marked: Mother of [[July uprising martyr Sajid sleeps with his t-shirt]] for comfort
headline: Mother of July uprising martyr Sajid sleeps with his t-shirt for comfort
summary: Lipi Begum, mother of Jagannath University student Ikramul Haq Sajid, shared her heartbreaking grief at a commemorative event.
details: Lipi Begum, the mother of Ikramul Haq Sajid, a student of the Accounting and Information Systems department at Jagannath University, spoke emotionally at a discussion meeting held on Tuesday.
Sajid was killed during the July uprising of 2024. His father passed away in August 2025, leaving Lipi Begum and her daughter as the only surviving family members.
During the event, she shared that she sleeps every night holding one of her son's t-shirts to her chest, which serves as her only source of solace.
The event, titled 'July Mass Uprising: From Spark to Ongoing Revolution,' was organized by the Jagannath University branch of the Jatiya Chhatra Shakti.
The discussion was attended by several dignitaries, including Opposition Chief Whip Nahid Islam, MP Abdullah Al-Amin, and university officials.
Also present was the mother of Shahriar Khan Anas, a child from Gendaria who was killed after participating in the movement by writing letters.
caption:
“I sleep every night with my Sajid's t-shirt to my chest.”

Lipi Begum, the mother of Ikramul Haq Sajid, a student of the Accounting and Information Systems department at Jagannath University, spoke emotionally at a discussion meeting held on Tuesday.

Sajid was killed during the July uprising of 2024. His father passed away in August 2025, leaving Lipi Begum and her daughter as the only surviving family members.

During the event, she shared that she sleeps every night holding one of her son's t-shirts to her chest, which serves as her only source of solace.

The event, titled 'July Mass Uprising: From Spark to Ongoing Revolution,' was organized by the Jagannath University branch of the Jatiya Chhatra Shakti.

The discussion was attended by several dignitaries, including Opposition Chief Whip Nahid Islam, MP Abdullah Al-Amin, and university officials.

Also present was the mother of Shahriar Khan Anas, a child from Gendaria who was killed after participating in the movement by writing letters.

#Bangladesh #JulyUprising #JagannathUniversity #Martyr #Justice

Source: Prothom Alo
